purpose: This table is the carrier reference lookup from the nycflights13 Bureau of Transportation Statistics source, mapping the sixteen two-letter carrier codes that flew out of New York City in 2013 to their full airline names, intended to feed joins against flight fact tables that record only a carrier code.
usage: Join downstream flight records to this table on carrier_code to attach the human-readable carrier_name; treat carrier_code as the unique grain key with no nulls expected.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the sixteen carriers that operated NYC departures in 2013 per the nycflights13 source and will not include carriers outside that scope; all three Airbyte capture-metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as non-business data, and no null or duplicate-row issues were observed (null_rate 0.0 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across all 16 rows).
